hypotheses.justification: Another hypothesis already gives this one. In TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Borel/Basic.lean, `IsBorelOverAlgClosed k H I` is defined as `IsAlgClosed k ∧ Minimal (IsBorelCandidate k H) I`, and it only needs `[Field k]`. So `hI.1` (or `((isBorelOverAlgClosed_iff _ _ _).mp hI).1`) is a proof of `IsAlgClosed k`. In Mathlib, `IsAlgClosed` is a Prop-valued class, so nothing depends on which proof of it is used. The fix: omit the variable, start the proof with `haveI : IsAlgClosed k := hI.1`, and keep the rest of the proof unchanged. The proof calls `isBorelOverAlgClosed_iff_exists_eq_conjugate`, which needs the instance, and it now gets it from `hI.1`. The rest of the statement (`IsBorelCandidate`, `IsBorelOverAlgClosed`, `HopfIdeal.conjugate`, `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.of`) only needs `[Field k]`, so it still elaborates without the instance. There is no degenerate case to worry about: `hI` is always among the remaining hypotheses.
